method.policy: 105 preclassified entries are retained without deleting or changing their community labels. The daily digest is a discovery layer, not proof of mechanism or measured benefit. Only ten PR descriptions and their changed-file paths have been checked; the other 95 PR statuses and source heads remain unknown.
method.screening: The research classification is assigned only to checked PRs; unreviewed entries explicitly remain not-yet-reviewed.
method.researchFramework: R2 editorial organization: distribution and state contract → cost model → Candidate → Verify → Hybrid State → Runtime → cross-layer synthesis → research gaps; 105 candidates unchanged and ten detailed PR cases.
